version_strings.string: Firmware External Version: V$version_no /* firmwareversion runtime node <- buildver 2.05 */

notes: manifest firmware_version '205b03_ALL_de_20101123' does not appear literally in rootfs; internal identity is version 2.05 (buildver/externalversion) with builddate 2010-11-23, exactly matching the '2.05b03' + '20101123' components of the manifest string; no contradicting version strings found

image layout: uImage LZMA kernel at 0x60 (Linux 2.6.21, MIPS, created 2010-11-23) + SquashFS 3.0 little-endian with non-standard D-Link magic 'shsq' and lzma compression at 0xE0080 (2319736 bytes, 1080 inodes); extracted via binwalk -Me (sasquatch backend)

binwalk rewrote 11 absolute symlinks to /dev/null; original targets recovered via 'sasquatch -lls' on the raw squashfs and all restored as equivalent relative links: tmp->var/tmp, etc/TZ->var/TZ, etc/hosts->var/hosts, etc/ppp->var/etc/ppp, etc/resolv.conf->var/etc/resolv.conf, dev/log->var/logs, www/syslog.rg->var/log/message, www/tsyslog.rg->var/log/tlogsmsg, www/auth_img->var/auth/auth_img, sbin/sgi->sbin/atp, sbin/xgi->sbin/atp, plus etc/init.d/S03config.sh->etc/scripts/config.sh, etc/init.d/S10system.sh->etc/scripts/system.sh, htdocs/upnp/{upnpdev.cgi,wfadev.cgi}->usr/sbin/upnpkits, htdocs/upnp/xmldoc->var/upnp (var/* are runtime tmpfs paths)

web UI lives in www/ (PHP pages incl. DevInfo.php, tools_firmware.php) with locales under www/locale/; htdocs/ contains only upnp; command.php was not present in this firmware's www/ (relevant for downstream CVE verification of CVE-2013-10069/CVE-2013-10048 which target command.php)
excluded non-firmware zip entries: DIR300B_langpack_de.bin (langpack), Bitte_zuerst_lesen_!!!_DIR-300RevB_Update.txt, changes.txt, WICHTIGE Hinweise zur Internet-Verbindung.pdf

arch determined from 3 largest ELFs (lib/modules/rt2860v2_ap.ko, usr/sbin/wps, bin/busybox): all ELF 32-bit LSB MIPS32 v1 -> mipsel; platform is Ralink RT3052 (etc/RT3052_AP_2T2R_V1_1.bin, rt2860v2_ap.ko)
